t: 詹姆斯·斯科特(James Scott) 第1任蒙茅斯公爵在布里奇沃特宣布自己为英格兰国王.
te: James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth declares himself King of England at Bridgwater.
dz: 蒙茅斯起义:詹姆斯·斯科特(James Scott) 第1任蒙茅斯公爵在布里奇沃特宣布自己为英格兰国王.
de: Monmouth Rebellion: James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth declares himself King of England at Bridgwater.

dz: 巴尔的摩的沙克:巴尔的摩的爱尔兰村庄被巴巴里奴隶商人所攻击.
de: The Sack of Baltimore: The Irish village of Baltimore is attacked by Barbary slave traders.

dz: 霍克斯特战役发生在三十年战争期间.

t: "阿纳格尼条约"是教宗为结束西西里卫斯珀斯人之战而调解的一次尝试,由阿拉贡王冠,法兰西王国和那…

dz: "阿纳格尼条约"是教宗为结束西西里卫斯珀斯人之战而调解的一次尝试,由阿拉贡王冠,法兰西王国和那不勒斯王国所签署.
de: The Treaty of Anagni, an attempt mediated by the papacy to end the War of the Sicilian Vespers, is signed by the crown of Aragon, the kingdom of France and kingdom of Naples.

dz: 迈克尔一世·科姆内诺斯·杜卡斯是伊庇鲁斯专制统治的第一任统治者,他与威尼斯共和国签订条约并成为他们的巫师.
de: Michael I Komnenos Doukas, the first ruler of the despotate of Epirus, signs a treaty with the Republic of Venice and becomes their vassal.

te: First Battle of Uji, starting the Genpei War in Japan.
dz: 第一次乌地战役,开始日本源北会战.
de: First Battle of Uji, starting the Genpei War in Japan.

t: 弗拉维乌斯·艾提乌斯出战匈奴阿提拉. 战役无果后,阿提拉撤退. 尽管遭受了灾难性的损失,导致他…
te: Flavius Aetius battles Attila the Hun. After the battle, which was inconclusive, Attila retreats. Despite suffering cat…
dz: 查龙斯战役:弗拉维乌斯·艾提乌斯出战匈奴阿提拉. 战役无果后,阿提拉撤退. 尽管遭受了灾难性的损失,导致他们同哥特人的联盟倒闭并摧毁了罗马军队的大部分,但尽管没有任何明显的军事成功,罗马人还是宣布了胜利.
de: Battle of Chalons: Flavius Aetius battles Attila the Hun. After the battle, which was inconclusive, Attila retreats.  Despite suffering catastrophic losses that led to the collapse of their alliance with the Goths and the destruction of much of the Roman army, the Romans nevertheless proclaimed victory despite the lack of any clear military success.
